customers.evidence: Our customers’ success is critical to our growth and we’re committed to succeeding together.

employees.evidence: Find incredible opportunities to grow your career at an award-winning workplace

dei.evidence: Ensuring that all voices are welcome and heard increases our awareness of what is possible.

shareholders.evidence: Our success depends upon our customers’ success.

integrity.evidence: Nothing is more important to our company than the privacy of our customers’ data.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, upbeat tone framed around Trailblazers and the Ohana family metaphor, with four named core values. Customers are addressed first and most often; employees and community follow. Mostly first-person plural with absolute phrasing ('Nothing is more important'), though 'hopefully' hedges the world-changing claim. Awards and scale statistics dominate proof points.
